lines: No one is me but me
With a gloomy face
Piling up nights I ended up crying
This unending daily life
I piled it on again today
Every time I hoped
That tomorrow might get better
I hid today behind the vanity mirror, over and over
The me in the reflection blinked again and again
Easily shaken by my changing heart
But the moment I closed my eyes, surprisingly
Thinking it's not so bad, I
Came to understand tomorrow
No one is me but me
That goes without saying, though
So even feelings that go unrewarded
I'll sort them out
And want to keep living
That's normal, isn't it?
I feel like I've broken out of my shell
I heard someone's voice, but
I was supposed to be shut inside that shell
I'm no longer there
Try being me, hey
You want to be me, don't you?
With words that wouldn't come out as voice
I left myself in a cloud of smoke
It's embarrassing to say, but
Things only I can protect
If I wear myself down weaving them
It might not be so bad, actually
No one is me but me
That goes without saying, though
So even feelings that go unrewarded
I'll sort them out
I want to keep on living, I think
No one is me but me
No one can take my place
I take out today
So I won't run away
Threw it into tomorrow and opened my eyes
No one is me but me
It seems you're the same
Looks like no one can take anyone's place
We turned our backs and said it to each other
So I'm not afraid anymore
I'll wait for the hours past midnight
Today too, unrewarded
I'll sort out my feelings
I want to keep living, I think
I breathed in
